entities.name: PMID:27490118
observations: Nauta et al., PLoS One 2016; title: HIF-2α Expression Regulates Sprout Formation into 3D Fibrin Matrices in Prolonged Hypoxia in Human Microvascular Endothelial Cells; DOI:10.1371/journal.pone.0160700.

entities.name: HIF-2α (EPAS1)
observations: In hMVECs exposed to 1% O2 for 14 days, siRNA silencing partially restored VEGF-A/TNFα-stimulated sprouting into 3D fibrin; HIF-1α or HIF-3α silencing had no effect. This supports a contributing, not exclusive, inhibitory role.

entities.name: HIF-2α-dependent sprout inhibition
observations: After 14 days at 1% O2, hMVECs failed to sprout into fibrin after VEGF-A/TNFα stimulation; HIF-2α siRNA partially rescued sprouting, while HIF-1α/3α siRNA did not. Prolonged hypoxia also reduced uPA independently of HIF-2α.
